filter_metadata_keep_valid: filter a metadata dictionary to keep only entries with truthy values
capture_logger_output: capture logging output from one or more loggers using a context manager
read_stream_value: read captured log stream output and clear the stream buffer
redirect_pymupdf_logs: redirect pymupdf messages into a Python logger via LoggerStream context manager
configure_logger_handlers: configure loggers with a shared StreamHandler and INFO level via LoggerStream
